description: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe. They can refine results naturally through conversational follow-ups, access rich hotel details including traveler photos, recent reviews, amenities, compare price offers and click out seamlessly to booking partners or Tripadvisor for deeper research.
